title: HTML Heading Extraction - CLI Changes
description: Walkthrough of CLI changes to support dual-format heading extraction for hlx library show

steps.title: Added filePath to local type
steps.description: Extended LibraryItemDetail.item with optional filePath field to consume the server's new API response.

steps.title: HTML heading regex (new, tried first)
steps.description: Matches <h1>-<h6> tags with optional id attribute. Extracts level, id, and raw text (stripping nested HTML tags). Uses id for anchor lookup when present, falls back to slugify().

steps.title: Markdown heading regex (preserved as fallback)
steps.description: Original Markdown regex /^(#{1,6})\s+(.+)$/ kept unchanged. Only runs if the HTML pattern doesn't match, ensuring backward compatibility.
